attach_collision_geoms: attach primitive collision geoms to bodies in an MJCF model using a dictionary of geom parameters
binding: bind MJCF elements to a MuJoCo physics instance and return a non-optional binding object
default_collision_geoms_kwargs: get the default shared kwargs dictionary for uniform collision geom color, contype, conaffinity, and group
review_attach_collision_geoms: review the attach_collision_geoms function to understand how it merges shared kwargs with per-geom parameters
review_binding: review the binding function to understand how it validates physics.bind returns a non-None result
